responsibility_name: Ensure the dog is fed measured portions at set times

evidence.evidence_text: When the dog is hungry, he can press the button adjacent to the bowl up to twice a day to fill it with an exact dose of food. Once the button is pressed, the bowl will emit the voice message “Bravo” and the release of the food.

coding.rationale: The dog's button press dispenses an exact food dose up to twice a day, maintaining measured feeding; failure leaves the dog unfed.

responsibility_name: Keep the garden watered on summer nights

evidence.evidence_text: When the motion sensors detect no one in the garden, if it is summer and if the time is between 22:00 and 00:00 start the garden sprinkler and turn on the outdoor lights.

coding.rationale: In summer between 22:00 and 00:00 the garden sprinkler waters an empty garden, maintaining hydration on warm nights; failure dries the garden out.

coding.rationale: Soil humidity below 60% between 20:00 and 6:00 triggers the veranda sprinkler, maintaining overnight plant hydration; failure dries the plant out.
